confirm.title: Approve tablet
confirm.description:
{name} wants to join Njörun.

The tablet shows a six-digit code. Approve it only if that code is **{code}**.

data_description.name: Shown in Home Assistant and the start of the entity IDs: "Kitchen" gives select.kitchen_…. Choose it now, because renaming later does not change IDs that exist.

abort.tablet_approved: The tablet is approved. It appears under Devices in a few seconds; change its settings on its device page.
abort.tablet_not_waiting: The tablet is no longer waiting. Make sure it is switched on and can reach Home Assistant; it appears here again within a minute.
abort.approval_failed: The tablet could not be approved. Reload Njörun and try again from the Discovered card.

init.title: Manage Njörun
init.description: Profiles hold settings that several tablets share ({profiles} now). Settings of a single tablet are on its device page.

menu_options.edit_profile: Change the settings a profile gives its tablets
menu_options.add_profile: Create a profile for tablets that share settings
menu_options.delete_profile: Delete a profile no tablet uses
menu_options.remote_logging: Send the tablets' log to Grafana Loki, or switch that off
menu_options.network_profile: Set the Wi-Fi a profile gives its tablets
menu_options.network_tablet: Set the Wi-Fi and the IP addresses of one tablet

remote_logging.title: Remote logging
remote_logging.description: Every tablet sends its log records to this Grafana Loki server, including the log before an unclean restart. Enter the server address, for example `https://loki.example.org`. Leave empty to switch it off. Tokens, Wi-Fi passwords and codes are removed before anything is sent.

network_profile_wifi.title: Wi-Fi of {profile_name}
network_profile_wifi.description: The Wi-Fi network that the tablets of this profile join. Home Assistant sends it to a connected tablet, which tries it first and goes back to its previous network if it cannot reach Home Assistant. Password: {password_state}. Leave the password empty to keep it while the name stays the same; with another name an empty password means an open network. Clear the name to remove the credentials.

network_tablet_settings.title: Network of {tablet_name}
network_tablet_settings.description: Wi-Fi name and password override the profile for this tablet; clear the name to follow the profile again (password: {password_state}, empty keeps it while the name stays the same). For each interface choose DHCP or a static address with prefix length, router and up to two DNS servers separated by spaces. A change is tried by the tablet first; if it cannot reach Home Assistant afterwards it returns to its previous values.

error.invalid_configuration: The operation or settings are invalid. Refresh the integration and try again.
error.invalid_log_sink: Enter an http or https address without user name, password or parameters, for example https://loki.example.org.
error.invalid_ssid: The Wi-Fi name must be 1 to 32 bytes without control characters.
error.invalid_password: The password must be 8 to 63 characters or 64 hex digits.
error.invalid_address: The address is not a usable host address.
error.invalid_prefix: The prefix length must be 1 to 30.
error.invalid_gateway: The router must be another host address in the same subnet.
error.invalid_dns: Enter at most two DNS servers, each a unicast address.
error.static_incomplete: A static setup needs an address, a prefix length and a router.

abort.no_network_tablets: No tablet reports network interfaces yet.

capabilities_conflict.title: Capabilities of {tablet} conflict with its settings
capabilities_conflict.description: The tablet {tablet} reports capabilities that its current settings do not fit ({reason}). Home Assistant keeps the capabilities it stored. Change the conflicting setting; the tablet reports again when it reconnects.

network_no_association.title: {tablet} could not join the new Wi-Fi network
network_no_association.description: Home Assistant sent new network settings to {tablet}, but the tablet could not join the network. Check the network name and the password. The tablet went back to its previous settings, and Home Assistant does not send these values again. Change them to try again.

network_no_address.title: {tablet} got no usable address on the new network
network_no_address.description: Home Assistant sent new network settings to {tablet}. The tablet joined the network but received no address, or it could not use the static address. The tablet went back to its previous settings, and Home Assistant does not send these values again. Change them to try again.

network_no_home_assistant.title: {tablet} could not reach Home Assistant with the new network settings
network_no_home_assistant.description: Home Assistant sent new network settings to {tablet}. The tablet got an address but could not open its connection to Home Assistant. For a static setup, check the router and the DNS server. The tablet went back to its previous settings, and Home Assistant does not send these values again. Change them to try again.

network_rejected_values.title: {tablet} refused the network settings
network_rejected_values.description: Home Assistant sent new network settings to {tablet}, but the tablet did not accept them. They were malformed, expired, older than what the tablet already has, or not supported by its network interfaces. Home Assistant does not send these values again. Change them to try again.

install_firmware.name: Install firmware
install_firmware.description: Installs a firmware release on a tablet. Without a version the newest release of the tablet's update channel is installed. A release older than the running one is installed only with the downgrade flag.

version.name: Version
version.description: A release version such as 0.2.0. Empty for the newest of the channel.

allow_downgrade.name: Allow downgrade
allow_downgrade.description: Install a version older than the running one.
